docs: highlight Marko examples with a real grammar and refresh the demo

Marko code samples were highlighted with Prism's html grammar, which
can't parse concise-mode syntax and left most tokens unstyled. Adds a
small Prism grammar covering what the docs use — module statements, tag
variables, tag parameters, unquoted/parenthesized attribute expressions,
attribute method shorthand, ${} interpolation, and <script> blocks —
and switches the four Marko samples to it.

Also swaps the usage example for a bump-to-top lineup: clicking an
artist moves them to the front of the list, showing FLIP reordering
with a single expression and no buttons.
